items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjM1NDgyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--13e0373f0df488a752a30dc8cd134f110c51dc7a/Affiche-Skewb-petit.jpg) L’inscription est **gratuite** pour les **nouveaux compétiteurs** ainsi que les [**adhérents AFS**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion). Si ce n'est pas votre cas, l'inscription coûte 5€. Merci de lire attentivement les **conditions d'inscription, la [FAQ](#83610-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) et les [tutoriels AFS](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos)**. Pensez également à consulter l'onglet [Planning](#competition-schedule). ---- Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€. Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](#83610-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**. Make sure to read the [Schedule](#competition-schedule) tab.

items.name: Oahu FTO a Makapō 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDgyNDQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d739808be3a2373fd1129978150c3798d3405ee0/IMG_1309.png) ### The competition weekend in Oʻahu continues with an amazing side events competition! --- * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8) will provide you with most of the information you need. --- ### This competition will be specializing in niche events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events. If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [Cube Against Cancer Hawaii 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubeAgainstCancerHawaii2027), happening on January 30th, the day before.

items.name: Pickering Winter 2027
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted and registration fees will not be transferred across competitions. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Want to know when the next competition is? Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines Nationals 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMwMDA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--97a368da9c2de5730f34fd117f5c205ff16be083/SaintVincentandtheGrenadinesNationals2027_logo.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbXFIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--21ca44b60799bf464134d7d44eddd25b4260efdf/Cubing%20Frontiers%20LLC%20Banner%20Transparent.png) The first WCA competition in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines! 🇻🇨 Cubers of all ages and skill levels are encouraged to sign up. This competition serves as the **2027 National Championship for Saint Vincent and the Grenadines**. Competitors of all nationalities are welcome to participate; however, only competitors who are nationals of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines are eligible to receive prizes.
